headline: Comulytic Note Pro: Cheapest AI Notetaker with 45-hour battery
summary: This slim device offers 64GB storage and processes notes using OpenAI's GPT-5 and Google's Gemini, all for a surprisingly low price after subscription.
details: AI notetakers, popular at CES 2026, aim to simplify note-taking by transcribing conversations and generating summaries. While the long-term impact on intellectual rigor is debated, they offer a convenient way to capture key points and meeting records.

The Comulytic Note Pro is highlighted as the most useful and cheapest AI notetaker tested. It boasts 64GB of storage and an impressive 45-hour battery life, capable of handling a full week of interviews without needing a recharge.

This device processes audio using both OpenAI's GPT-5 and Google's Gemini. It features a small, helpful LCD display and a slim design, weighing only 28 grams. It can be attached to a phone or stored in a wallet.
While many AI notetakers push paid subscription plans, the Comulytic Note Pro stands out for its value. Expect to pay around $15 to $30 per month for premium features on top of the hardware cost.

Beyond dedicated devices, services like Otter.ai and Google's Recorder app offer similar transcription and summarization features. However, physical gadgets like the Note Pro are beneficial for complex in-person scenarios where audio quality might be an issue or when you need your phone for other tasks.
